description: Propose a strict data-only ability; it stays pending until a steward reviews it. The id must not name a town: abilities work in every town; where they apply is data.

extension.description: The whole definition as one object { id, version, kind, title, purpose, fields }; or send those fields flat instead.

kind.description: 'commons' for a group's own use; 'commercial' for a business offer.

purpose.description: One sentence: what it helps a group know, at most 300 characters.

title.description: What it is called, at most 40 characters.

version.description: 1 for a new ability; a changed one is the next version.

name: extensions_propose
